title: Burst-Robust Codes for Life and Qubits: Correlated-Event Reliability, Holographic Erasure Recovery, and Finite Repair Capacity
description: Theoretical and synthetic-computational preprint. Cross-domain marked-event reliability framework with code-specific and biological recovery distinctions, plus a reproducible finite-lattice geometric benchmark. No physical quantum-code, radiation-transport, or biological validation is claimed.

creators.name: Devanik Debnath
